# FLX-3502: a value has no exact representation in the sink's format

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A sink writes every value exactly or not at all. An INT outside the signed 64-bit range has no Arrow integer type to hold it, and a DECIMAL whose precision exceeds 76 digits has no Arrow decimal type, so the sink refuses the stream rather than round, wrap or truncate a value the run computed. The message names the column, the row index and the value's class, never the value. Narrow the column's declared type in the FLUID contract, or write this stream with a sink that keeps values as text, such as the run directory's own NDJSON file.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3502
```
